completed_units: Consumed the durable finite discrete-adjoint checkpoint and preserved its exact no-new-constraint conclusion: repeated differentiation/SBP of the same evaluation adjoint closes back to F_2(1/2)=S_m-2 and cannot determine the independent LIFT digit.
Recovered and independently checked the source valuation-band decomposition G=G_T+pY mod p^2 and h=H_U+pA mod p^2, yielding Delta_p=Z_T+Gbar A+hbar Y mod p with Z_T=(G_T H_U-1)/p.
Proved the recovered absolute unit-core reduction is an exact all-target strict reduction: LIFT is equivalent to Z_T=R_p-Gbar A-hbar Y mod p, with middle and high valuation provenance retained.
Constructed the exact finite-Gauss cutoff parameter-jet bridge at a=p/6 and derived Z_T=[a_parent Psi-1]/p+a_parent H_1^{<=m}/6+Psi F_2^{<=2m}/72 mod p, with exact middle/high support recombination.
Proved a uniform rational first-order adjoint obstruction for the three-layer cutoff transport and identified the exact hypergeometric partial-period residual.

Proved the requested zero-edge gluing and finite-tail jet adjoints, and proved the first-order period extension is lossless but non-reductive: it reconstructs already-owned cutoff derivative terms and yields no equation for [a_parent Psi-1]/p or R_p.

Proved a supersingular Frobenius-route information no-go: the full ASD/Katz characteristic-polynomial recurrence is invariant under a p^2 shift of the p-1 coefficient and therefore cannot determine the next product digit; reduced the missing Frobenius information to one combined lifted comparison scalar.

Proved the Proposition-16 divided-power quotient at published precision is also insufficient: its pA[[xi]] denominator kills exactly a primitive p-layer that changes the product second digit; reduced the product observer to K_p=(a(p-1)b(p-1)+p)/p^2 mod p.
Derived the exact d=3, lambda=1/2 quartic-twist split: Delta_3=2, tau_p=(2^((p-1)/2)+1)/p mod p, and TRAW_p=tau_p-K_p mod p. The quartic factor must retain tau_p rather than only its Legendre sign.

Derived a coordinate-safe exact source-jet decomposition for the untwisted d=3 companion pair. Writing a_raw(p-1)=p alpha_p and defining J_p as the xi^(p-1)dxi coefficient of the Gauss-Manin source differential partial_lambda omega, the exact normalized companion b_raw=a_raw+c_p J_p gives Lcomp_p=(c_p alpha_p J_p-1)/p mod p and TRAW_p=alpha_p^2+Lcomp_p mod p. Hence K_p=tau_p-alpha_p^2-Lcomp_p mod p. Proved that retaining c_p only modulo p is not faithful.

Computed the raw d=3 coefficient digit alpha_p at source level by an exact all-target bridge. For p=6r+1, the exact H_{3,p-1}(t) coefficient satisfies H=F_{2r}-p D_p mod p^2; the finite quadratic transform has a p-divisible high-degree tail E_p because only indices r<k<=2r contribute and their (1/6)_k coefficient has exactly one p factor. Identified the transformed truncation G_{2r}(1/2) exactly with the already-owned finite-Gauss unit-band sum S, so alpha_p=G_T-D_p-E_p mod p. Consequently alpha_p is not an independent source/Frobenius scalar and the new companion-side information is reduced to the single scalar Lcomp_p. An independent exact checker verified the identities for all 166 target primes below 5000 with zero failures; finite checking is regression only.

Lifted the exact raw d=3 coefficient bridge one p-adic digit farther. For h1_j=H_{3j}-H_j and h2_j=H^{(2)}_{3j}-H^{(2)}_j, proved H_{3,p-1}(t)=F_n(t)-pD_p(t)+p^2 M_p(t) mod p^3 with M_p=1/2 sum A_j(h1_j^2-h2_j)t^j. Proved the finite quadratic defect is exactly p-divisible before reduction, so with GThat_p=G_n(1/2)/p mod p^2, alphaHat_p=H/p=GThat_p-D_p-E_p+pM_p mod p^2. This closes the raw coefficient port through p^3 without identifying the Gauss-Manin companion with an ordinary derivative. Exact regression over all 166 target primes below 5000 had zero failures; finite checking is not proof.

Proved the D25 Gauss-Manin representative-gauge information boundary and a typed fixed-xi first-digit companion bridge. An exact representative shift partial_lambda omega -> partial_lambda omega + d_rel(eta xi^p+...) changes J_p by p eta and therefore changes Lcomp_p by the unit c_0 alpha_0 eta modulo p while preserving the de Rham class, leading coefficient, all mod-p comparisons, and the published Proposition-16 mod-p^2 product statement. For the fixed-xi representative at d=3, lambda=1/2, derived J_p^(xi)=(sqrt(2)/4) partial_t H_{3,p-1}(t), proved from accepted D24 plus truncated Clausen that 6 beta_p J_p^F=1 mod p, and hence 6 alpha_p J_p^(xi)=1-6 C_p J_p^F with C_p=beta_p-alpha_p. Thus the period coefficient 6 cannot be substituted for the exact source companion normalization without the p-layer correction. A deterministic exact checker independently passed all 166 target primes below 5000; the observed witness 6 alpha_p J_p^(xi)=2 sqrt(2)-1 is regression only, not an all-prime proof.

Derived the explicit fixed-x Gauss-Manin representative G_x=-s(x+a)dx/(108D^3), exact primitive Q_lambda=sx/(108D(y+x+2a)) connecting G_xi=G_x+dQ_lambda, and proved by elliptic inversion plus residue in characteristic p that [xi^p]Q_lambda is in pA for every p>3 of good reduction. Hence J_x=J_xi mod p^2 and with unchanged exact c_p their D25 Lcomp observers agree. This rules out the natural fixed-x versus fixed-xi change as the missing D25 correction; no actual CM companion identification or LIFT evaluation is claimed.

Audited the ordinary versus divided-power formal cohomology lift boundary: an integral exact primitive need not vanish modulo pA[[xi]]. For fixed exact normalization and ordinary class, the missing source-bound lift difference is observed only through kappa_p=[xi^p]F mod p, changing the divided product by alpha_0 kappa_p. Arbitrary eta perturbations are not asserted to preserve the full Proposition-16 CM/Frobenius hypotheses. Four symbolic curve identities and four targeted prime regressions verify the implementation; the uniform vanishing theorem is proved algebraically.
